channel.title: UN Women News and Stories
channel.description: Latest news, high-level panel announcements, and statements from UN Women.

item.title: High-Level Ministerial Meeting on Gender Equality and Care Economy at UN Headquarters
item.description: New York: Ministers and civil society leaders convene on 16 September 2026 at 15:00 UTC to address systemic investments in unpaid care work and social protection frameworks globally.

item.title: Global Consultation on Eliminating Gender-Based Violence in Digital Spaces
item.description: Geneva: On 19 September 2026, UN Women hosts a multi-stakeholder dialogue on safeguarding women journalists, human rights defenders, and public figures online.
